- **Current attendance:**  
  \[
  \frac{405}{474}\times100 \approx 85.5\%
  \]

- **To reach 90 % of the 474 scheduled hours:**  
  \[
  0.90 \times 474 = 426.6 \text{ hours}
  \]
  You’d need at least **427 hours**.

- **Additional hours required:**  
  \[
  427 - 405 = 22 \text{ hours}
  \]

So you’re at about **85.5 % attendance**, and you’d need to attend **22 more hours** (roughly 22 more classes, assuming each class is 1 hour) to hit 90 %.
